## FORMAT with INTERVAL values
# Expected values: BigQuery's FORMAT documentation, which formats an INTERVAL for %t as
# 1-2 3 4:5:6.789 and for %T as INTERVAL "1-2 3 4:5:6.789" YEAR TO SECOND, and an ARRAY or a
# STRUCT with each value formatted by the same specifier; GoogleSQL compliance
# functions_testlib_interval.cc (GetFunctionTestsFormatInterval), which agrees with it.
# UNNEST prevents constant folding by the analyzer.

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789' YEAR TO SECOND AS a)]) AS s
=> "1-2 3 4:5:6.789"

SELECT FORMAT('%T', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789' YEAR TO SECOND AS a)]) AS s
=> "INTERVAL \"1-2 3 4:5:6.789\" YEAR TO SECOND"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789' YEAR TO SECOND)
=> "1-2 3 4:5:6.789"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(MAKE_INTERVAL(-1, -2, -3, -4, -5, -6) AS a)]) AS s
=> "-1-2 -3 -4:5:6"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(INTERVAL -20 MONTH AS a)]) AS s
=> "-1-8 0 0:0:0"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(INTERVAL -59 SECOND AS a)]) AS s
=> "0-0 0 -0:0:59"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(INTERVAL -123400 MICROSECOND AS a)]) AS s
=> "0-0 0 -0:0:0.123400"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(INTERVAL 123 MICROSECOND AS a)]) AS s
=> "0-0 0 0:0:0.000123"

SELECT FORMAT('%T', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(INTERVAL 10 YEAR AS a)]) AS s
=> "INTERVAL \"10-0 0 0:0:0\" YEAR TO SECOND"

SELECT FORMAT('%t|%T', s.a, s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS INTERVAL) AS a)]) AS s
=> "NULL|NULL"

SELECT FORMAT(s.f, s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS f, INTERVAL 5 SECOND AS a)]) AS s
=> null

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([INTERVAL 1 DAY, NULL, INTERVAL 2 HOUR] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[0-0 1 0:0:0, NULL, 0-0 0 2:0:0]"

SELECT FORMAT('%T', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([INTERVAL 1 DAY] AS a)]) AS s
=> "[INTERVAL \"0-0 1 0:0:0\" YEAR TO SECOND]"

SELECT FORMAT('%t', s.a) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(STRUCT('foo' AS a, INTERVAL 1 DAY AS b) AS a)]) AS s
=> "(foo, 0-0 1 0:0:0)"
